title: Analyses of the mechanism and therapeutic targets of senescence related genes in ischemic stroke with multi-omics approach

evidence_spans.quote: We identified 132 senescence-related DEGs
Ischemic stroke (IS) affects 11 million people annually
investigate senescence-associated gene regulation in IS
with multi-omics approach

scope_reviewer.uncertainty_reason: The report analyzes genes described as senescence-associated/related but does not explicitly analyze, induce, reverse, or compare a senescent state. It claims a multi-omics approach while explicitly supporting only transcriptomic gene-expression analysis.
scope_reviewer.concise_rationale: This is an original biological analysis of ischemic-stroke datasets with new results. Senescence is used as a gene modifier rather than an explicitly analyzed aging construct; the generic multi-omics claim does not identify a second molecular layer.

causal_design_reviewer.outcome: Senescence-associated gene expression and immune-cell profiles

evidence_spans.quote: machine learning-driven Weighted Gene Co-expression Network Analysis (WGCNA) identified core genetic signatures
A strong positive correlation ( r = 0.72, p < 0.001) between NFE2L2 and PTGS2 expression was observed.
CIBERSORT-based immune profiling showed altered lymphocyte/macrophage ratios in IS patients.

causal_design_reviewer.concise_rationale: The report applies differential-expression, network, profiling, and correlation analyses, without an intervention, instrument, temporal identification strategy, formal mediation, or directed causal model.

adjudication.outcome: Senescence-related gene-expression signatures and immune-cell profiles
